'''Kin''' is a juggler in [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]].

==History==
His brother is [[Bari (entertainer)|Bari]].

==Activities==
Valan Luca introduces Kin and various other entertainers to [[Elayne Trakand]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Thomdril Merrilin]], and [[Juilin Sandar]] when the group joins the show.{{ref/book|5|17}} Kin is also amoung those that bid the group farewell when they leave.{{ref/book|5|48}}
